Account

Sign in to save your notes and chat history to your account, so they follow you across browsers and devices instead of staying stuck in this one browser.

Signed in as .

API key settings

Your key is sent to your local proxy server and saved to its .env file. It never touches this browser page after saving, and the server refuses to accept changes from anywhere but localhost.

Email settings

The application (client) ID of the Azure AD app registration the Email tab signs in with (see app/src/setup-email-auth.js) — not a secret, just an identifier, saved to the same .env file as the OpenAI key above. Changing it doesn't sign you out; run the setup script again afterward if you're pointing at a different app registration.

The mailbox folder the Email tab syncs from (case-insensitive, checked among top-level folders and Inbox's children). Defaults to "Forwarded" if left blank.

Notes prompts

Each Schedule "Notes" button sends one of these prompts to the model, chosen by how that reading is classified (the second pill next to it). Edit a prompt below to change what gets asked for that type from now on, or reset it back to the built-in version. "Assignment" is the prompt the "Complete" button sends instead — it tells the model to do the assignment, not summarize it. Tasks (bring an item, attend something) don't get a button at all, so they have no prompt to edit.

Linked project folder

Save/Download and Open default into this repo's own notes/ folder once you've linked it. Click "Link folder now" and pick this app's "lawgpt" folder itself (the one containing lawgpt.html) — not the notes folder inside it; the app creates/uses the notes subfolder automatically from there. Picking anything else (e.g. notes itself, or an unrelated folder) is rejected rather than linked, so it can't create a stray notes folder somewhere unexpected. This link is remembered by your browser — it survives reloads and proxy server restarts, and stays linked until you use "Forget linked folder" below.

Assignment context

Add any documents this assignment needs beyond its own instructions, and write anything else the model should know. Saved context is sent together with the assignment's own matched document (if any) whenever you click Complete.

Scrape quiz from Canvas —

This starts a real attempt on this quiz in Canvas to read its questions and answer choices, then leaves that attempt open/unsubmitted — nothing gets filled out or submitted on your behalf. Your session cookie is used once for this and is never written to disk or logged.
